label_policy.category: Source dataset human label (demo_wardrobe_v1 expected_category). An extra accepted value marks a defensible alternative; strict accuracy uses only the first value.
label_policy.accepted_lists: A prediction is correct when its normalized value is in the accepted list. The first value is the preferred label.
label_policy.colors: Canonical names from garment_taxonomy.COLORS. Patterned items list every dominant color.
label_policy.patterns: solid, striped, plaid, floral, animal, graphic, print, lace, embellished. Surface texture (quilted, ribbed, knit, perforated) counts as solid.
label_policy.materials: Fiber families: cotton, denim, linen, wool, silk, synthetic, leather, knit. Visual material judgement is uncertain and is reported as plausibility, not ground truth.
label_policy.formality_level: 1-5 scale of the vision prompt; scored exact and within one level.
label_policy.independence: Labels confirmed in the app are not used: they equal the provider proposal on 59 of 60 demo items.
